code_block:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: k8s-secure-app
  namespace: diss-test
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: secure
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: secure
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: nginx@sha256:0d17b565c37bcbd895e9d92315a05c1c3c9a29f762b011a10c54a66cd53c9b31
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          securityContext:
            privileged: false
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-secret
              mountPath: /etc/secrets
              readOnly: true
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "256Mi"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8080
      volumes:
        - name: db-secret
          secret:
            secretName: db-secret
